explore-ground.title: The longest ground wave
explore-ground.prompt: Find the band with the longest ground wave, at least 200 km.
explore-ground.success: 160 m: the lowest frequency has the longest ground wave.

explore-nvis.title: Straight up
explore-nvis.prompt: On 5.3 MHz at midday, raise the radiation angle until the signal lands within 400 km.
explore-nvis.success: A high angle comes back down close by: that's NVIS.

explore-vhf.title: Through the ionosphere
explore-vhf.prompt: Raise the frequency until the signal goes through the ionosphere instead of coming back.
explore-vhf.success: Above the MUF the signal passes straight through. VHF normally works by line of sight.
